name: Light swell climax, released by a cut

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-2, 2026-11-26): a wordless lighthouse short builds its climax as a lamp's glow swelling until the dark frame flares, released by a cut outside.

technique: The climax is a light source growing until the whole dark frame flares, then a cut to a wide shot releases it. Brightness, not motion or sound, carries the peak.
purpose: Carry a story's peak with brightness rather than motion or sound.
visual_behaviour: A light source grows steadily in radius and intensity for about 3.4 s until the whole dark frame flares; it settles over half a second and a hard cut to a wide shot releases it.
mechanics: Lamp lit at 29.7 s; its glow radius and intensity rise steadily for 3.4 s; a frame-wide exposure lift peaks at 33.1-33.3 s; it settles over about 0.5 s; hard cut to the exterior at 34.60 s, 1.4 s after the peak (ref-1e22836116). No accent at the cut.

decomposition.timing: Swell 3-3.5 s; settle 0.5 s; cut 1-1.5 s after the peak.

use_cases: A device or idea switching on
The reveal of a result in a dark section
failure_modes: On a light canvas there is no headroom: use a dark section
Cutting before the peak deflates the climax

implementation.approach: Radial gradient on the light source plus a full-frame additive overlay whose opacity rises over 3-3.5 s to a peak, settles 0.5 s, then a hard cut 1-1.5 s after the peak. This approximates the impression; real light transport (volumetric glow, light falling on the set) needs a Blender plate.

capability.approximation: Radial gradient and overlay opacity give the brightness ramp; volumetric scattering and light falling on the surrounding shapes are lost.
capability.advanced_path: A Blender plate (visual-director, light-shafts template) when the climax must show real light on the set.

provenance.observed: The lamp brightens for 3.4 s until the frame flares at 33.1-33.3 s; the film cuts outside 1.4 s later.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
